The **Activation** group of the node palette has 14 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [ELU](../activation/elu.md) | Runs | Exponential linear unit. |
| [GELU](../activation/gelu.md) | Runs | GELU activation. |
| [Hardsigmoid](../activation/hardsigmoid.md) | Runs | Hardsigmoid activation: relu6(x + 3) / 6. |
| [Hardswish](../activation/hardswish.md) | Runs | Hardswish activation: x \* relu6(x + 3) / 6. |
| [Leaky ReLU](../activation/leaky-relu.md) | Runs | Leaky ReLU. |
| [Mish](../activation/mish.md) | Runs | Mish activation. |
| [PReLU](../activation/prelu.md) | Runs | ReLU with a learned negative slope. |
| [ReLU](../activation/relu.md) | Runs | ReLU activation. |
| [ReLU6](../activation/relu6.md) | Runs | ReLU6 activation: min(max(x, 0), 6) |
| [SELU](../activation/selu.md) | Runs | Scaled exponential linear unit. |
| [Sigmoid](../activation/sigmoid.md) | Runs | Sigmoid activation. |
| [Softmax](../activation/softmax.md) | Runs | Softmax activation. |
| [Swish](../activation/swish.md) | Runs | Swish activation. |
| [Tanh](../activation/tanh.md) | Runs | Tanh activation. |
